name: Chandra Nalaar
description: Chandra Nalaar is a human pyromancer and planeswalker from Kaladesh, raised by monks on Regatha, who is a founding member of the Gatewatch.

description_citations.text: "Chandra Nalaar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

summary.text: Chandra Nalaar is a human pyromancer and planeswalker from Kaladesh, raised by monks on Regatha, who is a founding member of the Gatewatch.

citations.text: "Chandra Nalaar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

bio.text: Facing execution after her village was burned, Chandra's spark ignited and she planeswalked to Regatha for the first time.

citations.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She stole the Dragon Scroll from the Sanctum of Stars on Kephalai, and her attack destroyed the Sanctum and killed everyone inside.

citations.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Chandra Nalaar", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Gideon tracked her down and turned her in, but she walked into the Purifying Fire, which spared her, and she destroyed the Order's forces.

citations.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Chandra Nalaar", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She later met Jace and Sarkhan at the Eye of Ugin, where their meeting loosened the Eldrazi's bonds.

citations.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Eldrazi", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: After Serenok's death she was chosen as abbot of Keral Keep, but she resigned and returned to Zendikar, where she freed her friends from Ob Nixilis and swore the oath that founded the Gatewatch.

citations.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Abbot of Keral Keep". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.
"Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Chandra Nalaar", section "The Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Channeling her flame through Zendikar's ley lines with Nissa's help, she incinerated Ulamog and Kozilek.

citations.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.
"Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

bio.text: On Kaladesh she found her mother Pia alive, fought her nemesis Baral, and helped destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.

citations.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.
"Kaladesh", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Chandra Nalaar", section "The Aether Revolt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: On Amonkhet the Gatewatch was defeated by Bolas, and Chandra, badly wounded, planeswalked away.

citations.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

bio.text: She left the group on Dominaria to become stronger under Jaya Ballard, helped disable and later reactivate the Immortal Sun in the War of the Spark, and afterward professed her love to Nissa.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.
"Chandra Nalaar", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

"Chandra Nalaar", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the Phyrexian invasion she went back to New Phyrexia with Wrenn, and Nissa was later un-compleated and Chandra chose to stay with her.

status.text: As of the latest story Chandra is alive: after Jace died in the Echoverse she escaped to Vryn.

citations.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Chandra Nalaar", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra Nalaar ignites in the moment of her execution.
timeline.quote: She ignites in the moment of her execution.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra, on Kephalai, handled authority figures with boom spells.
timeline.quote: Like that time on Kephalai, she'll prove she can handle those bozos just fine with the clever application of boom spells.

citation.text: "Planeswalkers Unmasked". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2007. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: After repeatedly leaving places engulfed in flames, Chandra decides to make fire her thing.
timeline.quote: After the fourth time Chandra left a place engulfed in flames, she decided to just go ahead and make it her thing.

citation.text: Seal of Fire (Duel Decks: Jace vs. Chandra, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra Nalaar warns invaders of her monastery to take it up with her inferno elemental.
timeline.quote: Those who wish to invade our monastery, please take it up with my servant.

citation.text: Inferno Elemental (Magic 2010, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra Nalaar asks who would want to ignite things one at a time.
timeline.quote: Who'd want to ignite things one at a time?

citation.text: Pyroclasm (Magic 2010, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The column describes planeswalkers as powerful, resourceful mages able to survive frontal assaults.
timeline.quote: They're resourceful, canny, spell-skilled, and battle-trained

citation.text: "Your Mailbox is Over Vorthosity". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Chandra Nalaar says the land of Zendikar seems to go out of its way to kill you.
timeline.quote: The land here seems to go out of its way to kill you.

citation.text: Seismic Shudder (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace and Chandra defeat Sarkhan at the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: With it, the pair defeated Sarkhan, knocking the entire group unconscious.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon, regretting how things ended with Chandra, follows her toward Zendikar, guessing she is chasing the Eye of Ugin from a stolen scroll's map.
timeline.quote: After a short time, he regretted the way things had ended and decided to find her.

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

timeline.summary: Gideon's tracking of Chandra dead-ends at a barren pass in Akoum.
timeline.quote: Chandra's trail dead-ended at a barren mountain pass in Akoum

citation.text: "The Battle of Fort Keff" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2010.

timeline.summary: Chandra gains the ability to wield colorless fire, which lets her unlock the Eye of Ugin in the Awakenings comic.
timeline.quote: Chandra gains the ability to wield colorless fire in order to unlock the Eye of Ugin in the Awakenings comic

citation.text: "Rise of the Inbox". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Chandra Nalaar appears in Anowon's camp asking for guidance, and he agrees once he learns she also seeks the Eye.
timeline.quote: One day, the young planeswalker Chandra Nalaar appeared in his camp, asking for Anowon's guidance.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Journey to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anowon discovers Chandra has a physical map and tries to kill her; Sarkhan Vol knocks him out.
timeline.quote: He soon discovered that Nalaar actually possessed a physical map and so tried to kill her.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "Journey to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anowon betrays Chandra and tries to kill her in her sleep; Sarkhan knocks him unconscious.
timeline.quote: Luckily for Chandra, Sarkhan Vol ambushed Anowon, rendering him unconscious with a swift strike to the head.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Journey to the Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The meeting of Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace in the Eye of Ugin loosens the Eldrazi's bonds and they rise to feed again.
timeline.quote: they rose to feed on the life of Zendikar again.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas sends Sarkhan to guard the Eye; Chandra and Jace, guided by Anowon, confront him there, and Chandra's invisible flame spell loosens the Eldrazi's bonds.
timeline.quote: thus unknowingly loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Second breaking". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan wanders the Eye of Ugin on Bolas's orders and saves Chandra from Anowon.
timeline.quote: he became lucid in time to save Chandra Nalaar from an attack by the vampire ruin sage named Anowon

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "The Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan attacks Chandra as a dragon; Jace and Chandra defeat him with Ugin's invisible fire, unlocking the Eldrazi confinement.
timeline.quote: But this action unwittingly opened the last lock of the Eldrazi confinement spell.

citation.text: "Sarkhan Vol", section "The Eye of Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Chandra, Sarkhan and Nissa's actions free the Eldrazi titans.
timeline.quote: freed the Eldrazi titans.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Release". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The meeting of Vol, Nalaar and Beleren at the Eye of Ugin loosens the Eldrazi's bonds.
timeline.quote: The meeting of Vol, Nalaar, and Beleren in the Eye of Ugin chamber loosened the bonds that kept the Eldrazi in torpor

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Japanese manga Eternal Blaze, based on the novel The Purifying Fire, begins serialization with tie-in Duel Decks featuring Jace and Chandra.
timeline.quote: Japanese Duel Decks: Jace vs. Chandra included alternate art cards as a tie-in for the comic.

citation.text: "Dengeki-Maoh", section "Dengeki-Maoh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: He asks whether Chandra will sink into impulsiveness or temper her emotions with discipline.
timeline.quote: Will Chandra sink into impulsiveness and callous disregard for life or will she temper her hotheaded emotions with a bit of discipline or by thinking first and acting from wisdom?

citation.work: Slime, Trials, and the Inner Garruk
citation.text: "Slime, Trials, and the Inner Garruk". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Chandra has a brief run-in with a blue mage, Jace Beleren.
timeline.quote: Chandra has a brief run-in with a blue mage

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra steals the Dragon Scroll in Kephalai and destroys Aretopolis's Sanctum of Stars by accidental overuse of power.
timeline.quote: she destroys Aretopolis 's Sanctum of Stars by accidental overuse of power

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon tracks Chandra down, incapacitates her and turns her in to the Prelate's officers.
timeline.quote: he incapacitates Chandra and turns her in to the Prelate's officers

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon follows Chandra to Diraden, where the prince's shroud of night prevents planeswalking, and Jurl attacks but is subdued.
timeline.quote: Gideon quickly subdues the being.

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Falia, smitten with Gideon, sends him hunting and summons Fog Riders to abduct Chandra; Gideon kills one Fog Rider before both are captured.
timeline.quote: slays one of the Fog Riders before both he and Chandra are incapacitated and abducted

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Velrav of planeswalkers to win Gideon better treatment, and Velrav decides to harness Gideon's essence.
timeline.quote: Velrav now believes he can harness Gideon's essence to become a planeswalker himself

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra beheads Prince Velrav with a sword of fire and King Gelidor impales himself on it, lifting the spell preventing planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Chandra creates a sword of fire and beheads the prince.

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samir reveals he has already met Gideon at the Order's headquarters, and Chandra feels betrayed and leaves Gideon.
timeline.quote: Feeling betrayed by Gideon's lies, she leaves him to fend for himself

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Order besieges Keral Keep and Chandra surrenders; Gideon escorts her to Walbert III, who plans to offer her to the Purifying Fire.
timeline.quote: When Chandra surrenders, Gideon is sent to escort her to the Order of Heliud's leader Walbert III .

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra confesses to Gideon her accidental part in the death of her village and parents.
timeline.quote: Chandra confesses to Gideon the accidental part she played in the death of her village and her parents

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra walks into the Purifying Fire, finds it has nothing to purify, and emerges unharmed and stronger.
timeline.quote: it finds nothing to purify and leaves Chandra not only unharmed but greatly bolstered in strength

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra destroys Walbert and his guards and collapses the temple.
timeline.quote: Chandra destroyed Walbert and his guards

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon promises to cover for her if she leaves, Chandra warns him of the Order's ideals, and she leaves for Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Chandra held her promise and left then for the plane of Zendikar

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra steals a scroll from the Sanctum of Stars on Kephalai; Jace is hired to recover it, leading both Planeswalkers to the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: the scroll Jace was hired to recover that later led both Planeswalkers fatefully to the Eye of Ugin on Zendikar

citation.work: Eleventeen M12 Art Tidbits. Also, Plants!
citation.text: "Eleventeen M12 Art Tidbits. Also, Plants!". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Magic 2012 changes the planeswalker lineup: Gideon and Sorin replace Ajani and Liliana, while Jace, Chandra and Garruk return in new versions.
timeline.quote: Instead of Ajani and Liliana, we see Gideon and Sorin.

citation.text: "Core Curriculum". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Chandra Nalaar destroys utterly.
timeline.quote: 'Utterly' is my favorite way to destroy something.

citation.text: Craterize (Magic 2013, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Magic 2014 is released as the 15th core set, spotlighting Chandra.
timeline.quote: The set puts the spotlight on Chandra .

citation.text: "Magic 2014", section "Set details". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Jace's help, Chandra casts a fire spell that cannot be seen and brings down the transformed Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: With his encouragement, she cast a fire spell that could not be seen

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Awakenings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra confronts Ramaz on Kaldheim; he escapes, revealing he served a greater dragon.
timeline.quote: After a skirmish, he escaped, revealing that he had only been a minion in a yet greater scheme

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Tracking Ramaz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Magic Origins storyline is announced: five Planeswalkers' emotional awakenings, which ignited their sparks, across ten planes.
timeline.quote: Each of these characters experienced an emotional awakening powerful enough to ignite their spark and change their lives forever.

citation.text: "Magic Origins: A New Era" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jun 2015.

timeline.summary: The five origin stories are scheduled in order: Chandra, Liliana, Jace, Gideon, Nissa.
timeline.quote: Over the next five weeks, you'll be able to read all five origin stories in this column.

citation.text: "Magic Origins: A New Era" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jun 2015.

timeline.summary: In the moment before her execution Chandra realizes what it meant to be a pyromancer.
timeline.quote: In the moment before her execution, she realized what it meant to be a pyromancer, to be alive, to be Chandra.

citation.text: Chandra's Ignition (Magic Origins, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The fire monks cannot keep up with Chandra in time.
timeline.quote: In time, not even the fire monks could keep up with Chandra.

citation.text: Ravaging Blaze (Magic Origins, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Automatons in the foundry turn to face Chandra.
timeline.quote: All around the foundry, automatons unhitched themselves from their mounts and pivoted to face Chandra.

citation.text: Foundry of the Consuls (Magic Origins, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In a flashback to her youth on Kaladesh, Chandra sets off a huge blast of fire to scare off her parents and runs away to the mountains.
timeline.quote: In an attempt to scare off her parents, she set off a huge blast of fire that caught several of the village huts on fire, before running away to the mountains.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Facing execution after her village is burned, Chandra's spark ignites and she planeswalks to Regatha for the first time.
timeline.quote: This traumatic moment ignited her Planeswalker spark, sending her to Regatha

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The page says Chandra's account was not the whole truth: the soldiers of the Consuls lit the fire in the village.
timeline.quote: The fire in the village wasn't lit by Chandra but by the soldiers of the Consuls, who were persecuting her.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Revised origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra steals the Dragon Scroll from the Sanctum of Stars.
timeline.quote: There, Chandra stole a scroll known as the Dragon Scroll from the Sanctum of Stars

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Fuel for the Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace tracks Chandra down at Keral Keep and fights her; he wins and completes his mission.
timeline.quote: Jace confronted her, and a fight broke out.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Fuel for the Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra's attack on soldiers destroys the entire Sanctum of Stars, killing everyone inside.
timeline.quote: her attack on a group of soldiers caused the entire Sanctum of Stars, a museum of artifacts and rarities of great power and value, to be destroyed, killing all those inside

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Gideon escape captivity on Diraden through a plan that ends in the death of Prince Velrav and the end of the plane's eternal night.
timeline.quote: she concocted a plan of escape with Gideon that culminated in the death of Velrav

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon reveals that he is an agent for the Order.
timeline.quote: Gideon revealed that he was an agent for the Order

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra enters the Purifying Fire with a clean soul; it accepts her and she destroys the Order's forces, burning Walbert to death.
timeline.quote: burning Walbert and many others to death and cracking the very foundations of the cavern

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra decides to leave Regatha and seek out Zendikar.
timeline.quote: She decided to leave the plane of Regatha forever and seek out the mystically powerful plane of Zendikar.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Serenok's death, Chandra is elected the new abbot of Keral Keep.
timeline.quote: After her mentor Serenok died, she was elected to become the new abbot.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Abbot of Keral Keep". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon seeks the Purifying Fire on Regatha and is tasked by Walbert with recovering Chandra.
timeline.quote: tasked Gideon with recovering the planeswalker known as Chandra Nalaar

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon follows Chandra to Kephalai and incapacitates her to save lives, later returning the Dragon Scroll.
timeline.quote: in an attempt to save innocent lives, he incapacitated Chandra

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Diraden Gideon and Chandra are captured by the Fog Riders after Falia's plot; Gideon kills one Fog Rider.
timeline.quote: Gideon showed up at an opportune moment and slew one of the Fog Riders

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra beheads Prince Velrav during his ritual, ending Diraden's Eternal Night.
timeline.quote: Chandra beheaded the prince

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Walbert reveals he plans to offer Chandra to the Purifying Fire; Gideon, guilt-ridden, finds a way for her to survive.
timeline.quote: he planned to offer Chandra to the Purifying Fire

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Fire spares Chandra and she destroys Walbert and his guards; Gideon promises to cover for her.
timeline.quote: The Fire spared Chandra and left her intact

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace tracks Chandra to retrieve the Dragon Scroll and erase her memory of it.
timeline.quote: his mission was to erase all memories of it from the pyromancer's mind

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra and the fire monks chant and dance in a lava field, but Serenok scolds her for not joining the spell properly.
timeline.quote: "The spell will fail if you don't participate."

citation.text: "Offers to the Fire" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: A hellion bursts from the lava field and attacks the monks.
timeline.quote: Something gigantic burst forth from the lava bed.

citation.text: "Offers to the Fire" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra climbs the hellion, tricks it into biting its own armor, and has the monks unleash their fire at her, weaving it into a spike that drives the hellion off.
timeline.quote: she wove the strands of fire together into a needle-sharp streak of blindingly hot fire.

citation.text: "Offers to the Fire" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Serenok tells Chandra she is ready and that she is Jaya.
timeline.quote: You're ready. You're her .

citation.text: "Offers to the Fire" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Mother Luti wakes Chandra to tell her Serenok is dead.
timeline.quote: "Chandra. Serenok is dead."

citation.text: "Offers to the Fire" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Serenok's memorial is held outside Keral Keep and Chandra, grieving, walks into the mountains.
timeline.quote: She walked away from the Keep, deeper into the mountains.

citation.text: "Offers to the Fire" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Luti presents Serenok's mantle and reveals the monks have chosen Chandra as the new abbot.
timeline.quote: "I'm here to tell you we've already chosen one."

citation.text: "Offers to the Fire" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra initially refuses to be abbot, then wavers when Luti repeats Serenok's phrase about the perfect challenge.
timeline.quote: Then, as Serenok was fond of saying, this will be the perfect challenge for you,

citation.text: "Offers to the Fire" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace burst into the chamber as Chandra considers accepting the mantle.
timeline.quote: "It's good to see you, Chandra," said Gideon Jura. "We need your help."

citation.text: "Offers to the Fire" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace ask Chandra to join them against the Eldrazi, and Jace reminds her of her responsibility for Zendikar's state.
timeline.quote: You have a hand in Zendikar's current state.

citation.text: "Offers to the Fire" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells them to go, saying she belongs on Regatha and has made a promise.
timeline.quote: "I belong here. I've made a promise."

citation.text: "Offers to the Fire" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace planeswalk away, and Chandra walks up the steps toward Mother Luti and the mantle.
timeline.quote: Chandra nodded to Mother Luti, and walked up the steps toward her.

citation.text: "Offers to the Fire" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Thousands of years later, Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace meet in the Eye of Ugin chamber, unintentionally loosening the bonds on the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: unintentionally loosened the bonds that kept the Eldrazi in torpor.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa, Chandra, Gideon and Jace swear an oath to stand together and form the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the Gatewatch was created.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis summons Kozilek and defeats Jace, Nissa and Gideon, capturing and torturing them until Chandra frees them.
timeline.quote: He summoned Kozilek and defeated Jace, Nissa, and Gideon.

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra frees her friends and scares Ob Nixilis away.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar showed up and freed her friends.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas manipulates Chandra and sends Sarkhan to the Eye of Ugin to release the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Bolas sent Sarkhan to the Eye and manipulated the pyromancer Chandra Nalaar into arriving at the same time.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nixilis takes Gideon, Jace and Nissa prisoner and tortures them until Chandra frees them and their attack scares him away from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Their concerted attack managed to scare the demon away from Zendikar

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Escape". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Saved by her halo, Tazri regroups with Noyan Dar, Drana and Munda and takes command, leading to Chandra's arrival.
timeline.quote: inspired by the angel she had killed so long ago, took command.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch binds both titans in leylines and Chandra burns them, ending Ulamog's material manifestation on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: This was the end of the material manifestation of Ulamog on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The death of Ulamog". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra, abbot of Keral Keep, cannot write her Mount Keralia Address and struggles to keep her promise to stay on Regatha.
timeline.quote: She had made a promise.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra planeswalks to Zendikar for just one peek and lands near Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: She pressed her will against the whereness around her, forcing it to change.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra watches Gideon direct the placement of a hedron into the ring over the water.
timeline.quote: One of the larger hedrons, hovering over the water, was moving .

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: A scout on a manta nearly spots Chandra, who runs into three Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: she was face-to-faceplate with a trio of angular, meaty-ribbed, bony-headed creatures.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra kills the three Eldrazi with fire.
timeline.quote: creating a tripartite blade of fire that sliced through each one of them.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: As she leaves, Chandra sees Ulamog advancing on Sea Gate and realizes this is what she helped unleash.
timeline.quote: This was what she had helped unleash.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Back on Regatha, Mother Luti summons Chandra to the Address, and Chandra burns her speech.
timeline.quote: The pages burst into flames, burning up in a flash.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra gives a clumsy address, then tells the monks to trust themselves and find their own purposes.
timeline.quote: trust yourself. Trust your gift.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra announces she is leaving for Zendikar and Mother Luti forbids it, invoking her promise.
timeline.quote: I forbid you to leave.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Mother Luti reveals it was a test, blesses Chandra's departure and takes back the abbot's robe.
timeline.quote: Go and save worlds.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra arrives at Sea Gate and finds Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring while Zendikari cheer.
timeline.quote: Ulamog was trapped.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: A winged demon draws power from the hedron prison, causing the hedrons to fall and freeing Ulamog.
timeline.quote: The circle was breaking.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra fails to hurt the demon or the titan, and a second Eldrazi titan rises from the ground.
timeline.quote: A second Eldrazi titan had entered the battle.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas arranges for Sarkhan Vol, Jace and Chandra to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.
timeline.quote: the elder dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas arranged for three Planeswalkers to converge on the Eye and unknowingly reactivate it.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon recruits Jace on Ravnica but not Liliana or Chandra, and the two return to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Together, Gideon and Jace returned to Zendikar to face the threat of the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra leaves Keral Keep for Zendikar and finds Ob Nixilis disrupting the hedron network.
timeline.quote: she left the Keep for Zendikar...only to find Ob Nixilis disrupting the hedron network.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri serves Kozilek and watches him kill Gideon, the other planeswalkers lying dead.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura burst, and a bloody bag of ruptured flesh and broken bones fell limply to the ash-white earth below

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon holds back the brood lineages while Chandra incinerates the bound titans.
timeline.quote: As Gideon kept the brood lineages at bay, Chandra incinerated the bound Eldrazi titans.

citation.text: Fall of the Titans (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra lures hellions into the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Chandra used jets of flame to lure hellions into the path of oncoming Eldrazi.

citation.text: Cinder Hellion (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis is surprised by Chandra.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis had prepared for every eventuality—except Chandra Nalaar.

citation.text: Devour in Flames (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch members swear their oaths to keep watch.
timeline.quote: For justice and peace, I will keep watch.

citation.text: Oath of Gideon (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra arrives at the Battle for Zendikar and frees Gideon, Jace and Nissa from Ob Nixilis, scaring the demon off.
timeline.quote: She managed to free them, and through a concerted attack they finally scared the demon away from the plane.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The four Planeswalkers swear an oath to stand together, forming the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the formation of the Gatewatch was a fact.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Channeling her flame through Zendikar's ley lines, Chandra incinerates Ulamog and Kozilek.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed, leaving only ashes raining from Zendikar's sky.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch chooses a direct attack: Nissa shapes the leylines into a binding glyph while Gideon lures the titans into the ambush.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura rallied the Zendikari defenders to lead the titans into the ambush

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The binding locks and the titans begin to tear apart; Chandra asks to attack but Jace insists on his plan.
timeline.quote: but Jace insisted on proceeding with his original plan

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra attacks and Nissa channels leyline mana to her, igniting the leylines and destroying both titans.
timeline.quote: The titans were destroyed in an enormous explosion.

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra channels fire through the leylines, incinerating Ulamog and Kozilek; Ugin is angered.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant stroke of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed, leaving only ashes raining from Zendikar's sky.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis traps Gideon, Jace, and Nissa while seeking the Eldrazi's power; Chandra frees them and they drive him from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar arrived in time to free her fellow planeswalkers, and together they forced Ob Nixilis to flee Zendikar.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On the cliffs of Tazeem the four pledge their oaths, founding the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Gideon, Jace, Chandra, and Nissa pledged their oaths to protect not only Zendikar but the entire Multiverse from threats too great to face alone

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Chandra's massive fire spell the Gatewatch kills the Eldrazi titans in Zendikar's Last Stand.
timeline.quote: Helped by a massive fire spell of Chandra, they succeeded.

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Formation on Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers swear an oath and found the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and founded the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra burns Ulamog and Kozilek through the ley lines, destroying both titans.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Gideon, Chandra and Nissa swear an oath, forming the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the formation of the Gatewatch was a fact.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "The Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ulamog and Kozilek are incinerated by Chandra's flames channeled through Nissa.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kiora urges releasing the titans but Chandra burns them through Nissa's ley lines, destroying Ulamog and Kozilek; Kiora leaves alone.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds and frees Nissa, Jace and Gideon from Ob Nixilis's cave.
timeline.quote: Luckily, Chandra Nalaar had arrived on Zendikar, found the trio, and freed them.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The four swear an oath to stand together, forming the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and the formation of the Gatewatch was realized.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Linked with Nissa, Chandra incinerates Ulamog and Kozilek.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed, leaving only ashes raining from Zendikar's sky.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace, Chandra and Nissa join forces against the Eldrazi titans Ulamog and Kozilek and the planeswalker Ob Nixilis, becoming the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: They become the Gatewatch , a team with a lasting commitment to protect the people of the Multiverse from threats that no one else can handle.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On the card Fall of the Titans, Chandra and Gideon take both titans out.
timeline.quote: In the second one Chandra and Gideon take them both out.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch", section "Notable cards". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace, Chandra and Nissa form the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: swear oaths to save the planes together, forming the Gatewatch .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra frees her friends, they scare Ob Nixilis from Zendikar and swear an oath, creating the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Thus, they swore an oath to stand together, and the Gatewatch was created.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Oath of the Gatewatch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra channels fire through Nissa and the ley lines, incinerating Ulamog and Kozilek.
timeline.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra searches the battlefield for Gideon and Jace while two titans wander the land and a swarm approaches.
timeline.quote: Too many to take on by herself.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Gideon's dented buckler in the mud and recalls her parents' deaths on Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: It was a large buckler shield, wedged in a depression of mud.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri and wounded scouts hail Chandra from a ravine and tell her the demon took Gideon and two others to a cavern.
timeline.quote: The demon took him, and two others.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra lures the Eldrazi swarm away from Tazri's wounded in a cyclone of fire.
timeline.quote: A roaring cyclone made of churning flame whirled across the field ahead of her

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra reaches the cavern, sees visions of her parents in the crust, and smashes the barrier.
timeline.quote: The crust exploded.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Gideon, Jace and Nissa suspended in midair by enervating magic and challenges the demon.
timeline.quote: I'm inviting myself,

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The demon overpowers Chandra, drains her fire and mimics her parents' voices to make her give up.
timeline.quote: You've failed them, Chandra. Just like you failed us .

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Chandra by telepathy to burn the Eldrazi drones, and she rallies and does so, freeing her friends.
timeline.quote: slamming into the Eldrazi drones that lurked near her friends.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The captives vanish into invisibility and reappear as the demon seizes Gideon by the neck.
timeline.quote: The demon already had him by the neck, raising him up off his feet.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Gideon, Jace and Nissa attack the demon together and defeat him.
timeline.quote: All four of them attacked the demon simultaneously.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra's fire cyclone blasts the demon, who promises revenge across the planes and vanishes.
timeline.quote: The air folded in on itself, swallowing the demon, and he was gone.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra and the others reunite as Nissa introduces herself, and the Eldrazi swarm Chandra lured arrives.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi swarm, the same horde that Chandra had lured away from Sea Gate, came skittering into the chamber

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon leads the planeswalkers out of the cavern and they scatter the Eldrazi swarm at the cave mouth.
timeline.quote: Gideon was the first to emerge from the cavern

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes none of them have left and argues that together the four can stand against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: But maybe four of us can,

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon swears an oath to keep watch against all threats to the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: For Sea Gate, for Zendikar and all its people, for justice and peace, I will keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra swears the oath, saying every world has its tyrants, and Nissa embraces her.
timeline.quote: If it means that people can live in freedom, yeah, I'll keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The four set out to find Tazri and form a plan.
timeline.quote: I left Tazri and a small group of soldiers a couple miles back that way.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers enter a ravine covered in Kozilek's trail and find Tazri, Munda, Jori En, Kiora and Drana's emissary arguing over a strike plan.
timeline.quote: Standing tall, bident in hand, cocky smile still in place, was the merfolk Planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa admits she removed the last failsafe and let the Eldrazi out, and Jace confesses he was part of the reason the failsafe was needed.
timeline.quote: I let them out, said Nissa.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace lays out the plan: lure the titans into an ambush, bind them with Nissa's leylines, and drain them, with Kiora clearing the basin and Chandra told not to attack the titans.
timeline.quote: When the time comes, Nissa weaves the leylines together and binds the titans.

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that the titans may get bigger as they are drawn into physical space, and Kiora agrees to follow the plan with a warning.
timeline.quote: Meaning they may get, um, bigger,

citation.text: "Brink of Extinction" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra serves breakfast heated with her hands, and Nissa brings blankets for her to warm.
timeline.quote: the blankets warmed.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Chandra the Eldrazi sweep seems done, and Chandra insists she is part of the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: I'm in this, Gideon. I'm part of the Gatewatch now.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Ugin lands furiously among the Zendikari, demanding to know what Jace has done.
timeline.quote: What have you done?

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Ugin scolds the planeswalkers for killing two ancient beings, says he will study their remains, tells Jace to leave, and warns of Sorin and Bolas.
timeline.quote: have proven to be an extremely arrogant and unreliable partner.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra talks Nissa into leaving Zendikar with the Gatewatch, saying Nissa can still protect it by standing with them.
timeline.quote: No one else can do it,

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra leads the group that baits Ulamog, while Gideon leads the other bait army toward Kozilek, toward Jace and Nissa waiting in the titans' path.
timeline.quote: The plan involved being as noticeably, tantalizingly alive as possible

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace and Kiora clear Eldrazi drones from the path of the bait army, with Kiora riding waves and sweeping them into a ravine.
timeline.quote: a wall of water swung around her like a sea god's punch

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The two bait armies cross in front of Nissa and Jace, and Jace signals them to disperse.
timeline.quote: Disperse the army. The titans are in position!

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The titans distort, the sky becomes the titans, and it begins raining Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: And then it began raining Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra wants to burn the titans but Jace forbids it, since damage would collapse the glyph.
timeline.quote: Any damage to the titans or to Nissa will snap the leylines and collapse the glyph spell.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon sides with Chandra, and Jace asks Chandra if she is certain she can destroy the titans with one spell.
timeline.quote: I'm certain

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra's spell fails to be enough as Gideon blocks a falling landmass with his own body.
timeline.quote: Gideon leaping from the outcropping, blocking the landmass with his own body

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa touches Chandra's shoulder, sending the mana of all Zendikar through her, and Chandra ignites the leylines.
timeline.quote: The leylines themselves caught fire

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The titans are destroyed in a blinding blast, and Chandra collapses.
timeline.quote: The world flashed with a roar of apocalyptic orange, then went blinding white.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Survivors gather in the ash with no celebration, and Kiora leaves with the bident.
timeline.quote: And she didn't stop walking for a long time.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives to Chandra's greeting and the smiling face of his friend.
timeline.quote: the afterimage of Emrakul looming above gave way to the smiling face of his friend.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Nissa arrive, and Jace lays out the plan: Nissa taps the leylines with her glyph, Gideon clears a path, and Chandra channels the energy.
timeline.quote: Nissa will use her planar glyph to tap into the leyline network.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra unleashes a huge firestorm against the mutated horde, scorching her friends, and the group is trapped in a market square.
timeline.quote: They were trapped in what had been a market square

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace has Chandra topple a lattice-scarred tower with two fireballs to block a street.
timeline.quote: Seconds later, the entire structure collapsed, blocking off most of the street

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa begins the planar glyph in the market square while Gideon charges the horde to protect her.
timeline.quote: He roared a challenge as he slashed in a wide circle

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to leave: they all walk out together or not at all.
timeline.quote: "Not gonna happen. We're all walking out of here together, or..."

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Gideon recoil from the Chain Veil, while Chandra defends Liliana as having saved them.
timeline.quote: "That...thing she carries. It's an abomination."

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben the Gatewatch is saved by Liliana; Chandra then defends the others during the sealing of Emrakul.
timeline.quote: When it became clear that they could not destroy Emrakul, Chandra joined Gideon in defending the other members of the Gatewatch while they conducted the sealing ritual.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Emrakul unfolds, growing countless tendrils and releasing a wave of power that hits every planeswalker.
timeline.quote: in that shifting Emrakul unfolded

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: The other planeswalkers collapse under Emrakul's mental assault, except Jace, who casts a spell in response.
timeline.quote: The other Planeswalkers crumpled, all except Jace, who cast some type of spell in response.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace sees a vision of child Chandra surrounded by guards who say they killed her parents, and she burns them all.
timeline.quote: I can make the whole world burn.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace links the group's minds; Jace and Nissa tell Chandra that burning Emrakul will not work.
timeline.quote: Trying to burn Emrakul is throwing a torch into the ocean.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana wakes a hungover Chandra at noon in Jace's house.
timeline.quote: Morning, Liliana

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana guesses Chandra spent the night at the Izzet air races.
timeline.quote: You went to see the Izzet air races.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana notes Nissa has barely left the roof garden since the first morning.
timeline.quote: She's been staying in the roof garden ever since.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana explains she keeps her own lodgings because she dislikes relying on others, hiding that she will not sleep under a roof Jace paid for.
timeline.quote: I mislike relying on the mercy of others

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra storms out of the meeting furious at Baan's description of the renegades.
timeline.quote: Chandra's chair tilted over backward as she bolted to her feet.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra rages that the Consulate killed Kaladesh's best inventors as she punches Gideon's punching bag.
timeline.quote: They killed the best damn inventors on Kaladesh.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon's punching bag bursts into flames and Chandra puts it out with a bucket, leaving a sand pile.
timeline.quote: The canvas of Gids's punchybag bursts into flames.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra wonders whether she belongs and thinks of returning to Regatha.
timeline.quote: I should go back to Regatha.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra remembers floating in green when she touched Nissa's mind and is drawn to seek her out.
timeline.quote: She was floating in green and I could breathe there.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Nissa sitting on moss in her flower-filled room.
timeline.quote: She's sitting cross-legged on a patch of moss.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra clumsily tells Nissa that on Zendikar she felt Nissa's calm mind behind the world's anger.
timeline.quote: But behind Zendikar, behind the anger and the power, I felt you

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa offers to teach Chandra to meditate.
timeline.quote: I can teach you to meditate, if you wish.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Mortified, Chandra flees Nissa's room.
timeline.quote: I turn and run, trailing sparks, trees and flowers smearing around me, banging through the door.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra rushes past Baan and Gideon, apologizing for blowing up the punching bag.
timeline.quote: SorryIblewupyourthingy

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Chandra hiding in an alley and persuades her to come along shopping.
timeline.quote: She was crouched halfway down an alley three blocks from Jace's home

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana invites Chandra to join her and talk on the way.
timeline.quote: Then I suppose you'll have to come along and see.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Baan about what Nissa and Chandra did on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: I was telling Minister Baan what you did on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Lavinia reports that Liliana and Chandra spent the afternoon in the market district and then planeswalked together.
timeline.quote: They spent the afternoon wandering the market district

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan explains that Chandra's parents, hunted after she manifested pyromancy, were reported dead when Bunarat was set ablaze.
timeline.quote: the girl escaped custody when she manifested dangerous pyromantic abilities

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon defends Chandra, saying her parents' sins have nothing to do with her.
timeline.quote: But her heart's the size of the moon.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa says Chandra's past was hers to share, since everyone has scars others should not touch.
timeline.quote: We all have scars we don't want others to touch.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa volunteers to go to Kaladesh with Baan and stand with Chandra.
timeline.quote: I'll stand with her.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra planeswalks back to Kaladesh for the first time since she left.
timeline.quote: Before she could take a deep, soothing breath, though, she had arrived.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra resolves to find the renegade inventor she believes is in danger, though the Gatewatch does not care.
timeline.quote: Somewhere in this crowd was the renegade she sought

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana appears on the balcony next to Chandra, having followed her.
timeline.quote: Standing on the formerly unoccupied balcony next to her was Liliana

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana persuades Chandra to celebrate her return while still looking for the renegade.
timeline.quote: Then I think it's high time we celebrated your grand return to your hometown.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Chandra's search turns into mingling with inventors and dancing.
timeline.quote: Chandra's and Liliana's search for the renegade had become a series of chats with renegade sympathizers

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana throws her drink in a Consulate vedalken's face and introduces Chandra as a renegade sympathizer.
timeline.quote: tossing her drink into the vedalken's face

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: When the soldier pulls out restraints, Chandra punches him unconscious.
timeline.quote: Chandra's fist arced around and collided with his jawbone in one fluid motion.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Liliana flee out the back of the nightclub.
timeline.quote: Chandra hopped a guardrail and ducked through the back of the nightclub.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra shows Liliana a worn mosaic of her father Kiran and says her parents were killed when she was a child.
timeline.quote: They were killed when I was a child.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra blames a uniformed officer named Baral for her parents' deaths.
timeline.quote: My parents died because of him.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana urges Chandra to find Baral and burn him, and Chandra swears he will pay.
timeline.quote: I swear he's going to pay for what he did.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chased by Consulate guards, Chandra refuses Liliana's lethal option and blocks the alley with a wall of fire.
timeline.quote: spreading into a wall of fire that spanned the alley's width

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Liliana jump onto the Aradara dawn train to escape.
timeline.quote: Chandra ran and stepped up, putting her hand in the way as the doors tried to close.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: The train stops amid an aether disruption that Chandra attributes to the renegade.
timeline.quote: A disruption. The aftermath of some kind of aerial display.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra burns open the train door and they leap off to reach the disruption.
timeline.quote: Chandra hot-punched the door handle.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra calls to the hooded man, who runs away through the crowd.
timeline.quote: he dashed away from them, through a bank of onlookers and around a Consulate checkpoint.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: The woman with Chandra's auburn hair stuns Chandra, who is shocked.
timeline.quote: She had auburn hair like Chandra's, but darker

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra, gaping at the woman with hair like hers, speaks to her as her mother.
timeline.quote: gaping at the woman with the hair like hers

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: In a Dhund cell Baral tells Pia he killed her daughter and tosses a melted piece of Chandra's vent pack, stamped K.N. and the leaking spire, as a memento (flashback).
timeline.quote: I killed your daughter today, Pia.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral blames Chandra for his scars and Pia answers that a mother could not be prouder.
timeline.quote: this is the work of your child.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia sees Chandra, grown and unmistakable, and is flooded with memories.
timeline.quote: Older but unmistakable. Her little girl, now even taller than Kiran had been.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra charges the soldiers and burns a crowd of automatons.
timeline.quote: inundated a crowd of the machines with a generous bath of flames

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan orders the soldiers to isolate and contain the pyromancer with gearhulks.
timeline.quote: Isolate and contain. Gearhulks in the front line

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia kicks and bashes soldiers to draw Chandra's attention and stop her advance.
timeline.quote: You forgot assault!

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Chandra they must retreat as the soldiers drag Pia away.
timeline.quote: They have her! You can't risk it now; we have to go!

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana cruelly tells Nissa that Chandra ran from her and came to Liliana.
timeline.quote: She ran from you

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Oviya Pashiri comforts Chandra and says they will free her mother from the Consulate.
timeline.quote: when we find your mother and take her back from those Consulate soldiers, Chandra.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri brings Chandra and Nissa to Yahenni's party.
timeline.quote: this is Chandra and Nissa

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni admits he cannot say where the Consulate would hold a prisoner of Pia's standing.
timeline.quote: I don't know where the Consulate would take prisoners of Pia's standing.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra snaps that Yahenni would help if it were his parent.
timeline.quote: If it was your parent you'd help us,

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni offers Chandra and Nissa information in return for removing the enforcer and breaking the door.
timeline.quote: I'll give you the information you need if you'll help me.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra melts the lock of the bathroom door with a white-hot finger.
timeline.quote: quickly melts the locks with a white-hot finger to the metal

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni tells them Pia is at Dhund and Mrs. Pashiri warns that Baral is stationed there.
timeline.quote: Baral is stationed there.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Mrs. Pashiri leave at once to find Pia.
timeline.quote: We need to go now,

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri leads Chandra and Nissa to Gonti's night market, since the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath it.
timeline.quote: I'm told the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath the night market.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra rejects Nissa's offer of calm and says she only wants to find her mother.
timeline.quote: I want to find my mom.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa works out that the way aether flows through the city can guide them to the Dhund.
timeline.quote: It has to do with the way aether flows through the city.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra melts a steel door's handle with white-hot fire.
timeline.quote: A blast of white-hot fire leapt from Chandra's hand to engulf the door handle

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra kicks down a guard while Nissa's vines dismantle his automaton.
timeline.quote: Vines broke through the concrete floor and coiled around its legs

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa admits she cannot find Pia directly in the tunnels.
timeline.quote: Finding your mother down here is another matter entirely.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra snaps at Nissa asking if she even has a mother, and Nissa reveals that Ulamog destroyed her people's home of Bala Ged.
timeline.quote: it was the first place he destroyed

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra erupts at Mrs. Pashiri for leading them around in circles.
timeline.quote: You've been leading us around in circles while they have my mom?

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra steps through an illusory wall and discovers it is not real.
timeline.quote: disappearing through the stone as if it were a wall of water

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Beyond the illusion, the tunnels become clean, well-lit corridors lined with bureaucrats' offices.
timeline.quote: The tunnel network was utterly transformed.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Armored figures surround them and a scarred man, Baral, unmasks.
timeline.quote: One of the figures reached up and pulled off a filigree mask that covered his face.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra's firestorm is absorbed into Baral's hand device.
timeline.quote: the flames vanished as they reached him

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral raises walls that trap the three in a sealed chamber.
timeline.quote: she slammed into a wall that shot up from the floor

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral says Baan told him she was back and promises she will not escape again.
timeline.quote: Baan said you were back. I couldn't believe it.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral calls Chandra a pathetic freak of nature and tells her to burn all she likes and die more quickly.
timeline.quote: You'll die more quickly if you burn up the air.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa touches Chandra's back and briefly feels Chandra's fire in her soul.
timeline.quote: A channel opened between them

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra begs Baral to let the others and her mother go and kill only her, but he refuses.
timeline.quote: Kill me, just me.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra's wave of fire reflects back on her, and Nissa shields Mrs. Pashiri with her cloak.
timeline.quote: throwing her cloak over Mrs. Pashiri and trying to shield the older woman with her body

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes poison vapor is leaking into the cell to suffocate them faster.
timeline.quote: He means for us to suffocate more quickly after all.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa offers to fuel Chandra's fire with her mana to try to melt the door's hinges.
timeline.quote: Let me fuel your fire,

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Their focused flame fails against the counterspell and fizzles out.
timeline.quote: the last flames fizzling out in her hand

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Nissa that the Gatewatch is about not being alone and having a family on any plane.
timeline.quote: Having a family, no matter what plane we're on.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to leave the dying Mrs. Pashiri, and Nissa says she will stay with them, thinking of Chandra as her friend.
timeline.quote: I'll stay here with Mrs. Pashiri.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral built a trap for Chandra but did not expect a leonin with a twin-headed axe.
timeline.quote: When Baral constructed his trap for Chandra, he did not account for the arrival of an enormous leonin wielding a twin-headed axe.

citation.text: Impeccable Timing (Kaladesh, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra thanks Jace for butting in.
timeline.quote: Nobody asked you to butt in, Jace. But thanks.

citation.text: Dramatic Reversal (Kaladesh, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra says Baral took her family and she would do anything to face him.
timeline.quote: Baral took my family from me back then.

citation.text: Disappearing Act (Kaladesh, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Baral greets Chandra, calling her pyromancer.
