timeline.summary: A memorial service is held for Gideon on Theros and a statue is erected.
timeline.quote: A statue was erected in Gideon's honor on Theros as well.

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lazav disguises himself as Chandra so the real Chandra can disable the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Lazav disguised himself as Chandra, which allowed the real Chandra to disable the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Huatli remains on Ravnica after Chandra disables the Immortal Sun and later sings a poem for Gideon on Theros.
timeline.quote: There, she sang a poem for him.

citation.text: "Huatli", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Nissa, Saheeli, Lavinia and Lazav shut off the Immortal Sun at New Prahv after defeating Dovin Baan, using Azor's nine words.
timeline.quote: Chandra managed to shut it off with the spell

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Samut's behest Jaya and Chandra cremate the inactive Eternals.
timeline.quote: she and Chandra cremated the bodies of the now-inactive Eternals

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kiora stays on Ravnica after Chandra disables the Immortal Sun, then returns to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: opted to return to Zendikar instead

citation.text: "Kiora", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lazav disguises himself as Chandra to fight Dovin Baan, letting the real Chandra disable the Immortal Sun, then blinds Baan.
timeline.quote: He disguised himself as Chandra in the fight against Dovin Baan

citation.text: "Lazav", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the war, Chandra and Nissa profess their love for each other.
timeline.quote: At that moment, Chandra and Nissa professed their love for each other.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lazav disguises himself as Chandra to distract Dovin Baan, letting Chandra disable the Immortal Sun, and Lazav defeats Baan.
timeline.quote: Lazav defeated Baan, blinding him with throwing stars and causing him to planeswalk away.

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra reactivates the Immortal Sun and leaves Saheeli to guard it; after Bolas's defeat Saheeli disables it again on Jace's unknown plan to let Ugin and Liliana leave.
timeline.quote: After Bolas' defeat, Saheeli disabled the Immortal Sun for a second time.

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Samut remains on Ravnica after Chandra disables the Immortal Sun, helping the Gatewatch against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Samut was one of the few planeswalkers who chose to remain on Ravnica after Chandra disabled the Immortal Sun, helping the Gatewatch in their fight against Bolas.

citation.text: "Samut", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Samut's behest Chandra and Jaya cremate the inactive Eternals.
timeline.quote: At her behest, Chandra and Jaya cremated the bodies of the now-inactive Eternals.

citation.text: "Samut", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel frees Isona, who dampens Tezzeret's aether connection, and planeswalkers leave him a statue.
timeline.quote: They left him as a statue in his laboratory

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vraska and Dovin Baan fake his death, with Vraska severing his hand.
timeline.quote: during the fight, Vraska severed Baan's right hand to use as proof of a kill

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers fight alongside the Gatewatch against Bolas and his Eternals, unaware that Bolas is relying on their interference.
timeline.quote: Little do the Gatewatch suspect that Bolas has not only accounted for their interference, but he is practically relying on it.

citation.text: "War of the Spark", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lazav disguises as Chandra so she can disable the Immortal Sun, and he defeats and blinds Dovin, who planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Lazav defeats Dovin and leaves him blinded, forcing him to planeswalk away.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon has Chandra reactivate the Immortal Sun to trap Bolas on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Gideon has Chandra reactivate the Immortal Sun, trapping the elder dragon on Ravnica.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace, Lavinia, Gideon, Teferi, Chandra, Jaya, Ajani and Karn arrive and join the fight, and Gideon names the enemy the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Form up! The Eternals are still coming! We need to save as many people as possible!

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch renews its Oaths, and Nissa speaks hers for the first time.
timeline.quote: Never again. Not on any world.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace ask Chandra to return to New Prahv and reactivate the Immortal Sun to stop Bolas bolting.
timeline.quote: We want you to return to New Prahv and turn the Immortal Sun back on.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden overhears and backs the plan, and Chandra sets off with Rai, Nissa and guildmembers.
timeline.quote: They set off for New Prahv.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Jaya burn the remaining Dreadhorde to ashes with dignity at Samut's request.
timeline.quote: meticulously burned every last one—every last fragment—down to ashes

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Planeswalkers debate what to do with the Immortal Sun, and Ajani insists the Gatewatch renew its purpose.
timeline.quote: we need to confirm that the next time a threat rises, the Gatewatch will be there

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya swears the Gatewatch Oath and is accepted.
timeline.quote: Never again. For the living and the dead, I will keep watch .

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra wrap Gideon's armor in leaves and the Gatewatch leads a solemn procession.
timeline.quote: wrapped Mister Jura's armor in the leaves

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hunting Baan on Regatha, Chandra unknowingly helps Vraska's plan as Vraska severs Baan's hand to fake his death.
timeline.quote: Vraska severed Baan’s right hand to use as proof of a kill while Chandra believed she had delivered the killing blow.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Aftermath of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Amonkhet, Chandra obliterates the idol of Nicol Bolas, symbolically defeating the foe that haunted her.
timeline.quote: There, she unleashed her rage, obliterating the statue; symbolically defeating the foe that had haunted her.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Aftermath of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds peace with herself and knocks out Tibalt, delivering him to the authorities on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: she knocked him out and delivered him to the local authorities to deal with

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Aftermath of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jaya secretly tracks Liliana to Dominaria and escorts Kaya, Teyo and Rat to her.
timeline.quote: Jaya secretly tracked Liliana to Dominaria

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark Tibalt confronts Chandra on Zendikar and drives her to planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: he unleashed an attack on Chandra that caused her to planeswalk away from Zendikar

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Plaguing Chandra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
